summary: Two blocks: a purple head with graphic art, and a tabbed leader grid (management, sales, operations) with round portraits and an outlined Know more button. Needs 7 to 20 leaders in three groups with a LinkedIn link each.

sections.note: deep purple ground, small caps label, large title and lead left, a half-circle graphic in coral and print texture right

three wide tab pills on top (management, sales, operations); under it a lilac band with white rounded cards three per row, each a round portrait with a small blue LinkedIn badge, name, title and an outlined Know more pill (opens a profile)
